entries.title_en: Mother of a Young Daughter Alleges Misconduct at Two Havelis
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker asks Vaishnavs not to question women who speak about angikar, and alleges that haveli associates and even her own guru use women.
claims: Alleges that at two different havelis, people close to the Baba said they would do her two-and-a-half-year-old daughter's Naam Nivedan only if she took Brahma Sambandh again.
Alleges that the guru who gave her the Brahma Sambandh mantra also has the habit of using women.
Alleges that she has seen Vaishnavs who visit the haveli weekly being slowly lured in.
Alleges that people who stay close to the Bawas each have several affairs.
Alleges that men have no right to question a woman who comes forward about what happened to her.

entries.title_gu: Kacheguda police officer refusing to file FIR on cognizable offences, child kidnapping.
entries.title_en: Caller Alleges Kacheguda Police Refused FIR on Child Kidnapping
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that a Kacheguda police officer would not file an FIR for the illegal detention and kidnapping of his daughter and instead told him to delete posts and have his father file the complaint.
claims: Alleges that a Kacheguda police officer would not file an FIR for the illegal detention and kidnapping of his daughter.
Alleges that the officer told him to delete Instagram and Facebook posts and have his father file the complaint.
Alleges that his daughter was illegally detained in an office, is now outside India, and that a court order requires her return to Indian jurisdiction.
Alleges that the child was later sent to Abu Dhabi and that this is an international parental child kidnapping case.
Alleges that he asked the officer to lodge the FIR and asks what action the police have taken for six or seven months.

entries.title_gu: અંગીકાર પ્રથા માં ફસાવા નો. પ્રયત્ન કરાયેલી એક પીડાતા વૈષ્ણવ ની આપવીતી
entries.title_en: Woman Describes Attempts to Trap Her in the Angikar Practice
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that a Goswami Balak tried to pull her into angikar leela, came to her house at night, and that she saw the same practice on yatra and in other homes.
claims: Alleges that a Goswami Balak mentally tortured her because she was not ready to take part in his angikar leela.
Alleges that he told her to let people stay at her house so he could come at night and do leela, and that she refused.
Alleges that at one o'clock at night he came to her house, hugged her and kissed her forehead.
Alleges that a Vaishnav in Sion invited her to a supposed Manorath, took her into a decorated bedroom, and wanted a Goswami to do her angikar there.
Alleges that in Nathdwara he asked whether her complete angikar should happen there, and that she refused.

entries.title_gu: અંગિકાર પીડિતા એ પોતે જ આપેલ પ્રશ્નો અને શંકા ઓ ના જવાબ
entries.title_en: Speaker Explains Why She Still Visited the Haveli After Misconduct
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker explains that after a Balak came to her house at night she stopped going upstairs in the haveli, and went on Vraj yatra only with elders who stayed with her.
claims: Alleges that on the yatra a sister tried to take her during Sharad Manorath, which she found to be torture.
Alleges that after a Balak came to her house at night she could not sleep and would cry during seva.
Alleges that after a Balak came to her house at night she stopped going upstairs in the haveli.
Alleges that the first experience was with the Balak, and the second was when a Vaishnav called her to a house for a Manorath, which is how she learned of dalal Vaishnavs.
Alleges that she went on Vraj yatra only because elders in her pal knew her situation and promised to stay with her.

entries.title_en: Speaker Recounts Alleged Angikar by Navneetlalji in Junagadh
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that about 22 years ago, on Pavitra Agiyaras in Junagadh, Navneetlalji performed angikar with the speaker's friend inside the haveli.
claims: Alleges that about 22 years ago, on Pavitra Agiyaras, a Goswami performed angikar with the speaker's friend inside a haveli in Junagadh.
Alleges that a khavas, also called a dalal woman, told the friend to accept angikar and seated her on a bed in a back room.
Alleges that after the pavitra offerings he went into the bhitar and performed angikar with the friend.
Alleges that on the way home the friend told the speaker that he had sexual intercourse with her.
Alleges that even on the sacred day of Pavitra Baras, Vallabhkul misused their position and did not keep lust under control.

entries.title_en: Woman Describes How Relatives Tried to Draw Her into Angikar
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that relatives and a man who also used the name Tushar tried to draw her into angikar, first among Vaishnavs and then with a Bavashri in Kandivali.
claims: Alleges that relatives tried to draw her into angikar, first among Vaishnavs and then with a Bavashri in Kandivali.
Alleges that the plan was that she would first do angikar with him and then be taken to a Bavashri in Kandivali.
Alleges that a relative brought a Vaishnav to her house at night, saying Thakorji had given him prerna to come.
Alleges that when she was alone at home he explained the meanings of seva offerings in obscene language.
Alleges that they will blackmail a person who does angikar with them by mistake or under brainwashing.

entries.title_en: Poonamji Describes Alleged Misconduct During a Vraj Yatra
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that on a Vraj yatra about 15 years ago a Bawashri tried to hug her, that his followers pressed her to accept, and that London devotees also take part.
claims: Alleges that a man from the Haveli told her that in Junagadh a father leaves his own daughter with Babashri for the whole night.
Alleges that on a Vraj yatra about 15 years ago a Bawashri made gestures to hug her, then insulted her and told her to leave when she refused.
Alleges that the sakhis, the men around him, and Mukhiyaji all pressed her to accept.
Alleges that the sakhis who stayed near him would go to bathe him.
Alleges that people from London and other countries also take part and arrange long stays with Bawashri in Vraj.

entries.title_en: Purvi Describes Alleged Misconduct in Her Mother's Bombay Vaishnav Satsang
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that women in her mother's Vaishnav satsang circle in Bombay engage in intimate physical conduct and claim divine encounters with Thakorji, and argues that this defames the marg.
claims: Alleges that members described Thakorji drinking their milk and doing leela with them at night.
Alleges that Vaishnavs perform angikar on each other, before Bavashris do, and that she saw this with her own eyes.
Alleges that she saw women in her mother's Bombay satsang hug and kiss each other and feed each other lip to lip, calling each other gopi.
Alleges that her mother told her that questioning these practices would bring aparadh.
Alleges that a guest who stayed overnight at her family's Bombay flat later said Thakorji was doing leela with her.

entries.title_en: Lawyer Confronts Maganbhai Over Alleged Angikar Talk on Vraj Yatra
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker confronts Maganbhai by phone, alleges that he asked three sisters about angikar on a Vraj yatra, and presses him to admit he wanted sexual pleasure.
claims: Alleges that a village elder asked three sisters on a recent Vraj yatra whether they had had angikar.
Alleges that he talks of doing angikar with women from all over the village.
Alleges that he has village girls do angikar but has not had his own daughter do it.
Alleges that after being pressed many times, the man said from his own mouth that he wanted to enjoy bodily pleasure.
Alleges that the speaker is a lawyer and will file a complaint and bring the police to Bhesan.

entries.title_en: Vaishnav Woman Alleges Misconduct Involving Sister and Daughter
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that a man did not spare sisters, made a video call to her daughter when she was alone, and says they will not do seva of Vallabh Kul.
claims: Alleges that a man does not even spare anyone's sisters.
Alleges that he could video call her daughter and asked if she was alone so he could talk to her.
Alleges that during that call he used suggestive words about her body.
Alleges that she stood behind her daughter and heard this.
Alleges that they want to do Thakurji's seva and do not do Vallabh Kul's seva.

entries.title_en: Nandkumar Gandhi Campaigns Against Alleged Angikar by Balaks in Bapunagar
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker presents a pamphlet against angikar and alleges that Balaks and their associates in Bapunagar and Surat misuse women in the name of religion.
claims: Alleges that men take turns using a woman who comes to a house for seva, and that she became pregnant.
Alleges that people are told they attain Bhagvat prapti if they do angikruti with balaks.
Alleges that an unmarried girl became pregnant after being used at a man's house, and that she named him when a doctor threatened a police case.
Alleges that perverse teachings of angikruti leela are used to misuse unmarried women, married women, and widows in the name of religion.
Alleges that some Balaks have sexual contact with women during menstruation, calling it khata goras.

entries.title_en: Vaishnav Alleges an Elder Aimed Angikar Talk at His Wife
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that an elderly Vaishnav turned a health visit into talk of angikar aimed at the speaker's wife, and urges support for those who speak against the practice.
claims: Alleges that an elderly Vaishnav turned a health visit into talk of angikar aimed at the speaker's wife.
Alleges that the man said Baba had not partaken of beautiful samagri for a long time, speaking with intent toward the speaker's wife.
Alleges that the man said the tilak Thakorji wears is of a woman's private parts.
Alleges that about two days later he went to Junagadh after hearing an explanation of Kamakhya Dosh.

entries.title_en: Allegations and Evidence Concerning the Angikar Practice
entries.summary_en: The speaker alleges that a 16-year-old girl was raped and criticizes religious authorities and community members for defending alleged offenders and demanding photographic or video evidence.
claims: Alleges that photographic or video evidence is demanded to establish sexual assault.
Alleges that a 16-year-old girl was raped and experienced bleeding.
Alleges that community members overlook serious wrongdoing by religious figures.
Alleges that people demonstrate insufficient concern for the safety and dignity of other people's daughters.
